purpose: Hardware comparison for asynchronous eye-texture copying and repeated absent-XR-file opens
build_method: Diagnostic APK asset replacement. Zig 0.13.0 (Clang 18) cross-compiled the C++17 ARM64 Linux driver/presenter with target aarch64-linux-gnu.2.31, -O2 -fPIC -shared -fvisibility=hidden -pthread -Wl,-z,defs, Vulkan-Headers v1.3.296 and repository Wayland stubs/protocol. C++ runtime linked statically; DT_NEEDED: libwayland-client.so.0, libm.so.6, libpthread.so.0, libc.so.6, libdl.so.2. Android build-tools 35 aligned and signed with repository test key.
pre_install_validation: Actual presenter concurrency regression fails with the old flat-path early return and passes with copy completion and shutdown wakeup. The renderer is held manually; no GPU is used in this test.
XR file backoff/reappearance/live-read regression and existing head-pose/optical-controller regressions pass.
macOS presenter test uses temporary compatibility declarations for unused Linux socket, futex and dma-buf paths; production source is unmodified by these declarations.
Driver and presenter regression cross-compile for ARM64 Linux without host substitutions. Cross-compiled regression not executed on device.
APK signer matches previous diagnostic APK; only the driver asset and root signature entries differ.
limitations: Not a full Gradle/native rebuild; APK version label inherited from donor.
Closing the early-return window does not implement the missing SteamVR sync-texture handshake. Hardware effectiveness against snapping is unconfirmed before installation.
